Designed to complement early childhood education, this comprehensive activity booklet focuses on *Knowing the Environment*. Developed by Litera, these educational supplies serve as essential work materials for kindergartens, providing structured learning through engaging activities and games tailored specifically for preschool students. This volume is designed for the "Large Group" level (ages 5-6).
